evidence: one file mixes boundary parsing, product behavior, persistence, formatting, and UI mapping
large touched file has unrelated sections and no clear owner
function performs multiple unrelated side effects
rules.remediation: Move boundary work to adapters, product behavior to the owning feature or service, and formatting to a named helper only when reuse is real.

evidence: files named misc, helper, helpers, common, manager, thing, or utils contain unrelated exports
new helper name does not explain the domain or technical responsibility
barrel exports unrelated helpers as one bucket
rules.remediation: Rename by purpose, split unrelated helpers, or move feature-specific behavior back to the owning feature.

evidence: shared helper has only one real caller
shared code contains feature-specific product nouns
new shared folder appears before repeated need is proven
rules.remediation: Keep code feature-local until at least two real callers need the same stable behavior.

evidence: domain or service logic repeatedly checks unknown external shapes
boundary data is passed through without parsing
UI or core logic repeats defensive server-shape checks
rules.remediation: Parse and normalize data at transport, persistence, job, form, or vendor boundaries before calling core logic.

evidence: TODO has no owner, reason, or removal condition
comment describes behavior that no longer matches the implementation
rules.remediation: Keep comments for why, constraints, tradeoffs, and temporary decisions; remove comments that only restate obvious code.

evidence: behavior changed with no focused test or smoke check
closure report lists no proof command for product logic change
rules.remediation: Run or add focused proof that would fail if the changed behavior were wrong, or record why proof was skipped.
